_doc: v3 settings for the uller (tools/art/v3/v3_mech.py), fit and labels from the v2 work on the same sculpt.
name: uller

source.title: BattleTech Kit Fox (Uller) Alt Config V
source.author: MiniHulkMechs
source.notes:
The source is a kitbash. Per its README, the torso and legs are by Syllogy ("Kit Fox Prime, aka Uller for Battletech", https://www.printables.com/model/1863957, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), and the Arrow IV launcher is by MKHand_Industries, from "Urbanmech Builder" (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/urbanmech-builder).

**The Arrow IV launcher's licence is unverified.** Cults3D could not be checked automatically, and MiniHulkMechs' CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 grant may not cover that part. On 2026-10-25 Lee (project owner) decided to keep this kitbash with that part's licence unverified. If the launcher's licence turns out not to allow this use, swap in Syllogy's Kit Fox Prime.

boxes._why: the right shin's rear plate (z 0.7-1.9 m) is shin, not foot

lowpoly._why: 2026-10-25: this kitbash is a soup of overlapping shells; Blender's collapse crumples it into shards at any ratio (torso, feet), so no part is decimated beyond merge + 1 deg planar dissolve (~130k tris)

_glass_mode_why: three tiny eye slits: the texel knife follows Lee's line; whole-patch snapping made lumps and lost the left slit
_glass_mirror_why: Lee outlined the visor slit's left side in the 3/4 view; the right side is only seen edge-on, so it is mirrored
